name: Minecraft Crossplay (Reliable)
author: nolangelinas@gmail.com
description: Paper with Geyser, Floodgate, ViaVersion and MCXboxBroadcast. Bedrock connects over NetherNet; every start refreshes plugins from checksum-verified official downloads and keeps the current jars if anything fails.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

SERVER_ROOT="${SERVER_ROOT:-/mnt/server}"

mkdir -p "${SERVER_ROOT}/plugins/Geyser-Spigot/extensions" "${SERVER_ROOT}/.crossplay/previous"

cat > "${SERVER_ROOT}/start-minecraft.sh" <<'CROSSPLAY_LAUNCHER'
#!/bin/bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
STATE_DIR="${ROOT}/.crossplay"
PREVIOUS_DIR="${STATE_DIR}/previous"
DOWNLOAD_DIR="${STATE_DIR}/downloads"
VERSION_FILE="${STATE_DIR}/minecraft-version"
USER_AGENT="nrgserver-minecraft-crossplay/1 (+https://github.com/nrgbistro/calagopus-eggs)"

PAPER_JAR="server.jar"
GEYSER_JAR="plugins/Geyser-Spigot.jar"
FLOODGATE_JAR="plugins/floodgate-spigot.jar"
VIAVERSION_JAR="plugins/ViaVersion.jar"
XBOX_JAR="plugins/Geyser-Spigot/extensions/MCXboxBroadcastExtension.jar"

log() {
  echo "[crossplay] $*"
}

warn() {
  echo "[crossplay] WARNING: $*" >&2
}

fail() {
  echo "[crossplay] ERROR: $*" >&2
  exit 1
}

enabled() {
  case "$2" in
    1|true|TRUE|yes|YES|on|ON) return 0 ;;
    0|false|FALSE|no|NO|off|OFF) return 1 ;;
    *) fail "$1 must be a boolean value" ;;
  esac
}

sha256_of() {
  perl -MDigest::SHA -e 'print Digest::SHA->new(256)->addfile($ARGV[0], "b")->hexdigest' "$1"
}

version_lt() {
  perl -e '
    my @a = split /\./, $ARGV[0];
    my @b = split /\./, $ARGV[1];
    for my $i (0 .. ($#a > $#b ? $#a : $#b)) {
      my $order = ($a[$i] // 0) <=> ($b[$i] // 0);
      exit($order < 0 ? 0 : 1) if $order;
    }
    exit 1;
  ' "$1" "$2"
}

fetch() {
  curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
    --user-agent "${USER_AGENT}" \
    --connect-timeout 10 --max-time "$3" \
    --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 \
    --output "$2" "$1"
}

# Prints "<url> <sha256> <label>" for the newest release described by a publisher's metadata.
resolve() {
  perl -MJSON::PP -e '
    my ($kind, $file) = @ARGV;
    open(my $fh, "<", $file) or die "cannot read metadata\n";
    my $data = do { local $/; JSON::PP->new->decode(<$fh>) };
    my ($url, $sha, $label);
    if ($kind eq "paper") {
      my $build = $data->[0] or die "no stable build\n";
      my $download = $build->{downloads}{"server:default"};
      ($url, $sha, $label) = ($download->{url}, $download->{checksums}{sha256}, "build $build->{id}");
    } elsif ($kind eq "geyser" || $kind eq "floodgate") {
      my ($version, $build) = ($data->{version} // "", $data->{build} // "");
      die "unexpected version\n" unless $version =~ /^[0-9A-Za-z.+-]+$/ && $build =~ /^[0-9]+$/;
      $url = "https://download.geysermc.org/v2/projects/$kind/versions/$version/builds/$build/downloads/spigot";
      ($sha, $label) = ($data->{downloads}{spigot}{sha256}, "$version build $build");
    } elsif ($kind eq "viaversion") {
      my $release = $data->{result}[0] or die "no release\n";
      my $download = $release->{downloads}{PAPER};
      ($url, $sha, $label) = ($download->{downloadUrl}, $download->{fileInfo}{sha256Hash}, $release->{name});
    } elsif ($kind eq "xbox") {
      my ($asset) = grep { $_->{name} eq "MCXboxBroadcastExtension.jar" } @{ $data->{assets} // [] };
      die "no extension asset\n" unless $asset;
      ($sha = $asset->{digest} // "") =~ s/^sha256://;
      ($url, $label) = ($asset->{browser_download_url}, "build $data->{tag_name}");
    }
    die "incomplete metadata\n"
      unless defined $url && $url =~ m{^https://} && defined $sha && $sha =~ /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
    print "$url $sha $label\n";
  ' "$1" "$2"
}

# Installs the newest verified release over DESTINATION, keeping the replaced jar for rollback.
# Any failure leaves the current jar untouched and returns non-zero.
refresh() {
  local name="$1" kind="$2" metadata_url="$3" destination="${ROOT}/$4"
  local metadata download url sha label

  metadata="$(mktemp "${DOWNLOAD_DIR}/metadata.XXXXXX")"
  if ! fetch "${metadata_url}" "${metadata}" 60; then
    warn "${name}: release metadata unreachable; keeping the current jar"
    return 1
  fi
  if ! read -r url sha label < <(resolve "${kind}" "${metadata}"); then
    warn "${name}: release metadata unusable; keeping the current jar"
    return 1
  fi

  if [[ -f "${destination}" && "$(sha256_of "${destination}")" == "${sha}" ]]; then
    log "${name} ${label} is current"
    return 0
  fi

  download="$(mktemp "${DOWNLOAD_DIR}/jar.XXXXXX")"
  if ! fetch "${url}" "${download}" 600; then
    warn "${name} ${label}: download failed; keeping the current jar"
    return 1
  fi
  if [[ "$(sha256_of "${download}")" != "${sha}" ]]; then
    warn "${name} ${label}: checksum mismatch; keeping the current jar"
    return 1
  fi
  if ! unzip -tqq "${download}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    warn "${name} ${label}: download is not a valid jar; keeping the current jar"
    return 1
  fi

  if [[ -f "${destination}" ]]; then
    cp -p -- "${destination}" "${PREVIOUS_DIR}/${destination##*/}"
  fi
  chmod 0644 "${download}"
  mv -f -- "${download}" "${destination}"
  log "${name} ${label} installed"
}

refresh_plugin() {
  if (( auto_update )) || [[ ! -f "${ROOT}/$4" ]]; then
    refresh "$@" || true
  fi
  [[ -f "${ROOT}/$4" ]] || warn "$1 is not installed; the next start with internet access will retry"
}

[[ "${MINECRAFT_VERSION:-}" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$ ]] ||
  fail "MINECRAFT_VERSION must look like 26.3, got '${MINECRAFT_VERSION:-}'"
if ! [[ "${BEDROCK_PORT:-}" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]{0,4}$ ]] || (( BEDROCK_PORT > 65535 )); then
  fail "BEDROCK_PORT must be a port number, got '${BEDROCK_PORT:-}'"
fi
[[ "${BEDROCK_PORT}" != "${SERVER_PORT:-}" ]] ||
  fail "BEDROCK_PORT ${BEDROCK_PORT} is the Java port; give Bedrock its own allocation, Geyser needs it for TCP and UDP"
advertise_address="${BEDROCK_ADVERTISE_ADDRESS-auto}"
if [[ "${advertise_address}" == auto ]]; then
  geyser_address_args=(-DgeyserStunDiscovery=true)
else
  perl -MSocket=AF_INET,AF_INET6,inet_pton -e \
    'exit((inet_pton(AF_INET, $ARGV[0]) || inet_pton(AF_INET6, $ARGV[0])) ? 0 : 1)' -- "${advertise_address}" ||
    fail "BEDROCK_ADVERTISE_ADDRESS must be auto or an IP address, got '${advertise_address}'"
  geyser_address_args=(-DgeyserStunDiscovery=false "-DgeyserAdvertiseAddresses=${advertise_address}")
fi
if ! [[ "${SERVER_MEMORY:-}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || (( 10#${SERVER_MEMORY} < 1024 )); then
  fail "set a memory limit of at least 1024 MiB on this server (SERVER_MEMORY=${SERVER_MEMORY:-unset}); the heap is sized from it"
fi

auto_update=0
enabled AUTO_UPDATE "${AUTO_UPDATE:-1}" && auto_update=1
xbox_broadcast=0
enabled XBOX_BROADCAST "${XBOX_BROADCAST:-1}" && xbox_broadcast=1

mkdir -p "${PREVIOUS_DIR}" "${ROOT}/plugins/Geyser-Spigot/extensions"
rm -rf -- "${DOWNLOAD_DIR}"
mkdir -p "${DOWNLOAD_DIR}"

recorded_version=""
if [[ -f "${VERSION_FILE}" ]]; then
  recorded_version="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "${VERSION_FILE}")"
fi
if [[ -n "${recorded_version}" ]] && version_lt "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" "${recorded_version}"; then
  fail "MINECRAFT_VERSION ${MINECRAFT_VERSION} is older than this world's ${recorded_version}; worlds cannot be downgraded, restore a backup taken on ${MINECRAFT_VERSION} instead"
fi

if (( auto_update )) || [[ ! -f "${ROOT}/${PAPER_JAR}" || "${recorded_version}" != "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" ]]; then
  if ! refresh Paper paper "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/paper/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}/builds?channel=STABLE" "${PAPER_JAR}" &&
    [[ -n "${recorded_version}" && "${recorded_version}" != "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" ]]; then
    warn "Paper ${MINECRAFT_VERSION} is unavailable; still running ${recorded_version}"
  fi
fi
[[ -f "${ROOT}/${PAPER_JAR}" ]] ||
  fail "Paper ${MINECRAFT_VERSION} could not be installed and there is no server.jar yet; check this server's internet access and start again"

# Judge the jar actually on disk, so a hand-restored older Paper cannot open an upgraded world.
jar_version="$(unzip -p "${ROOT}/${PAPER_JAR}" META-INF/versions.list 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 | cut -f 2 || true)"
if [[ "${jar_version}" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$ ]]; then
  if [[ -n "${recorded_version}" ]] && version_lt "${jar_version}" "${recorded_version}"; then
    fail "server.jar is Paper for ${jar_version} but this world has run on ${recorded_version}; worlds cannot be downgraded, restore a backup taken on ${jar_version} instead"
  fi
  if [[ "${jar_version}" != "${recorded_version}" ]]; then
    echo "${jar_version}" > "${VERSION_FILE}.tmp"
    mv -f -- "${VERSION_FILE}.tmp" "${VERSION_FILE}"
  fi
else
  warn "cannot tell which Minecraft version server.jar is for; only MINECRAFT_VERSION guards against a downgrade"
fi

# Bedrock clients update themselves, and a Geyser that predates their version locks them out,
# so the plugins track their latest releases rather than a pin.
refresh_plugin Geyser geyser "https://download.geysermc.org/v2/projects/geyser/versions/latest/builds/latest" "${GEYSER_JAR}"
refresh_plugin Floodgate floodgate "https://download.geysermc.org/v2/projects/floodgate/versions/latest/builds/latest" "${FLOODGATE_JAR}"
# Geyser always speaks the newest Java protocol; ViaVersion lets it (and updated Java clients)
# join while MINECRAFT_VERSION stays on an older release.
refresh_plugin ViaVersion viaversion "https://hangar.papermc.io/api/v1/projects/ViaVersion/versions?limit=1&offset=0&channel=Release&platform=PAPER" "${VIAVERSION_JAR}"
if (( xbox_broadcast )); then
  refresh_plugin MCXboxBroadcast xbox "https://api.github.com/repos/MCXboxBroadcast/Broadcaster/releases/latest" "${XBOX_JAR}"
elif [[ -f "${ROOT}/${XBOX_JAR}" ]]; then
  mv -f -- "${ROOT}/${XBOX_JAR}" "${PREVIOUS_DIR}/${XBOX_JAR##*/}"
  log "MCXboxBroadcast unloaded; its Xbox sign-in stays in plugins/Geyser-Spigot/extensions/mcxboxbroadcast"
fi
rm -rf -- "${DOWNLOAD_DIR}"

# 80% of the container limit leaves room for metaspace, Netty buffers and Geyser's native WebRTC stack.
heap_mb=$(( 10#${SERVER_MEMORY} * 80 / 100 ))
initial_heap_mb=$(( heap_mb < 1024 ? heap_mb : 1024 ))

cd "${ROOT}"
# Explicit endpoints disable STUN; auto mode must omit the address property so Geyser can refresh
# public mappings after an ISP address change instead of advertising only Docker's private address.
# Signaling is pinned to built-in because MCXboxBroadcast relays Xbox joins to it on BEDROCK_PORT, and
# an auto-updated Geyser could otherwise change its default.
exec java \
  "-Xms${initial_heap_mb}M" "-Xmx${heap_mb}M" \
  -XX:+DisableExplicitGC -XX:+ParallelRefProcEnabled -XX:+PerfDisableSharedMem \
  -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:G1HeapRegionSize=8M -XX:G1HeapWastePercent=5 \
  -XX:G1MaxNewSizePercent=40 -XX:G1MixedGCCountTarget=4 -XX:G1MixedGCLiveThresholdPercent=90 \
  -XX:G1NewSizePercent=30 -XX:G1RSetUpdatingPauseTimePercent=5 -XX:G1ReservePercent=20 \
  -XX:InitiatingHeapOccupancyPercent=15 -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200 -XX:MaxTenuringThreshold=1 \
  -XX:SurvivorRatio=32 \
  -Dterminal.jline=false -Dterminal.ansi=true \
  -DgeyserTransport=nethernet \
  -DgeyserSignalingMode=builtin \
  "-DgeyserUdpPort=${BEDROCK_PORT}" \
  "${geyser_address_args[@]}" \
  -jar "${PAPER_JAR}" --nogui
CROSSPLAY_LAUNCHER

chmod 0755 "${SERVER_ROOT}/start-minecraft.sh"
echo "[crossplay-install] launcher installed; the first start downloads and verifies Paper, Geyser, Floodgate, ViaVersion and MCXboxBroadcast"

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description: Paper release line to run; only stable Paper builds of exactly this version are installed. Raising it upgrades the world permanently, so back up first. Lowering it is refused.

variables.name: Bedrock Port
variables.description: Port of this server's second allocation. Geyser uses it for TCP signaling and UDP gameplay, so it must differ from the Java port.

variables.name: Bedrock Advertise Address
variables.description: Use auto for Geyser STUN public-address discovery with dynamic IPs. A literal IPv4/IPv6 address disables discovery and advertises only that address; a LAN IP permits LAN/VPN play only. Existing servers must change their saved LAN IP to auto for public Bedrock access.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Refresh Paper (same Minecraft version, stable builds only), Geyser, Floodgate, ViaVersion and MCXboxBroadcast on every start. Downloads are checksum-verified; any failure keeps the current jars.

variables.name: Xbox Friends Broadcast
variables.description: Load MCXboxBroadcast so consoles can join from the Friends tab through the bot account. Turning it off unloads the extension and keeps its sign-in.
